video_title: La Bombilla | Temporada 2 - Episodio 14: Adam Hanga

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on his decision to return to the ACB
quotes.excerpt: when the opportunity to return to play in the ACB came, it was an easy decision.
quotes.quote: When the opportunity to return to play in the ACB came, it was an easy decision. It is the league that I have played in for almost my entire career, and I have always wanted to play in a league like the ACB. When they called me, I did not have to think much. With my history in Barcelona, it has all been very simple.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Cuando vino la oportunidad para volver a jugar en la ACB, fue una decisión fácil. Es la liga que he jugado durante casi toda mi carrera, y siempre he querido jugar en una liga como la ACB. Cuando me llamaron, no tuve que pensar mucho. Con mi historia en Barcelona, todo ha sido muy sencillo.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on his lack of basketball knowledge before moving to Spain
quotes.excerpt: I was living in a bubble in Hungary, less than the Europeans, outside of Hungary I had not traveled.
quotes.quote: I was living in a bubble in Hungary, less than the Europeans, outside of Hungary I had not traveled. With my family, we never traveled, and we did not have the economic means. My family was not one that was traveling when I was small, and for that reason, for me, it was an experience and a very big change. I was 21 years old, and I was already a good player, but not at the level of Hungary, and for that reason, I had zero expectations.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo estaba viviendo en una burbuja en Hungría, menos de los europeos, fuera de Hungría yo no había viajado. Con mi familia nunca hemos viajado, no teníamos ni económicamente y tampoco mi familia no era una que estábamos viajando cuando era pequeño, y por eso para mí era una experiencia y un cambio bastante grande. Yo tenía 21 años, ya era un buen jugador, no en el nivel de Hungría, y por eso yo tenía cero expectativas.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on choosing Manresa as his first team in Spain
quotes.excerpt: The number one objective was that we wanted to play in the ACB.
quotes.quote: The number one objective was that we wanted to play in the ACB. My representative told me that I had to play in the ACB. I remember that this time I think we were between two or three teams, Alicante, Mallorca, and Manresa, but we had to wait to see who stayed in the first division. Two teams went down, and we were waiting to see who, and in the end, I signed with Manresa, which I think was an exceptional decision because I spent two wonderful years there.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: El objetivo número uno era que queríamos jugar en la ACB. Mi representante me ha dicho que no, lo tienes que jugar en la ACB. Yo recuerdo que esta época yo creo que estábamos entre dos o tres equipos, Alicante, y yo creo que Menorca y Manresa, pero teníamos que esperar a ver qué quién queda en la primera división, porque dos bajaron y entonces estábamos esperando a ver quién y al final fichó con Manresa que yo creo que fue una decisión excepcional porque ha pasado dos años maravillosos ahí.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on his individual performance during his second season in Manresa
quotes.excerpt: The second season with the team was fatal. We won four games in two years.
quotes.quote: The second season with the team was fatal. We won four games in two years with my national team and with Manresa. We have won very few games, but individually, especially in the second part of the second season, I think I played very good basketball, and because of that, I signed for Baskonia.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: El segundo con equipo fue fatal. Yo creo que fueron casi dos años que ha ganado cuatro partidos en dos años con mi selección y con Manresa. Hemos ganado muy pocos partidos, pero individualmente, sobre todo la segunda parte de mi segunda temporada, yo creo que individualmente ha jugado muy bien baloncesto, por eso gracias por eso ha fichado por Baskonia.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on his injury struggles during his time at Baskonia
quotes.excerpt: I started very badly in my time in Baskonia because I had problems with my knee.
quotes.quote: I started very badly in my time in Baskonia because I had problems with my knee. I had a lot of pain, and when I signed for Baskonia, they knew that there was a problem. We did a resonance and said that we were going to operate, an arthroscopy that in the end, I think I was going to be out for four to six weeks. During the whole summer, I was there in Baskonia, but in the end, it was not four to six weeks. My first game was in the first days of December.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: He empezado muy mal mi época ahí en Baskonia porque ya sabíamos los últimos meses que tenía problema con mi rodilla, que tenía mucho dolor, no sé qué y cuando fichó por Baskonia ellos saben que que hay un problema. Hemos hecho una resonancia y digamos que bueno vamos a operar, una artroscopia que al final yo creo que vas a estar fuera cuatro o seis semanas, durante todo el verano estaba ahí en Baskonia, pero al final no eran cuatro o seis semanas, mi primer partido fue en los primeros días de diciembre.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on his childhood in Hungary
quotes.excerpt: I lived with my grandparents for a long time until I was 15 years old.
quotes.quote: I lived with my grandparents for a long time until I was 15 years old. I do not know my father, so I left when I was two years old, and I was growing up in Budapest with my grandparents and with my mother. When I was 15, we decided that it was time to change because in Hungary, in Budapest, there were no teams in the first division, and I had an opportunity to go to another team, to Alba Comp, which later spent six years there, and practically there I grew up from a child to a man.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo vivía con mis abuelos durante mucho tiempo hasta que tenía 15 años. Yo no conozco mi padre, así que me fui cuando tenía dos años y entonces que yo estaba creciendo en Budapest con mis abuelos y con mi madre. Y cuando tenía 15 hemos decidido que bueno, era el momento para cambiar porque en Hungría, en Budapest, no había ningún equipo de primera división y tenía una oportunidad para ir a otro equipo, al Alba Comp, que luego pasó ahí seis años y prácticamente ahí crecí del niño a un hombre.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on his motivation to continue playing
quotes.excerpt: I am going to play until I have motivation, and until something motivates me.
quotes.quote: I am going to play until I have motivation, and until something motivates me. I ask myself, and I do not think I have much motivation to play in Hungary. I have had a career that I am very grateful for, and I do not want to return and break this image that people have in Hungary, that I have been a EuroLeague player for many years, that I have won everything, and to go to play in a league that is not at the level, I do not see it.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo voy a jugar hasta que tengo motivación, y hasta que me motiva algo. Y yo me pregunto a mí mismo y no creo que tengo mucha motivación para jugar en Hungría. Yo creo que he tenido una carrera que estoy muy agradecido por ella, y no quiero volver y romper esto, de esta imagen yo creo que tiene la gente en Hungría, que bueno, ha sido un jugador de Euroliga muchos años, no sé qué, que ha ganado todo y para ir a jugar en una liga que no está al nivel, no lo veo.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on the best Hungarian basketball players
quotes.excerpt: David Kornel, who has also played in the EuroLeague, in Baskonia, and is the only player.
quotes.quote: David Kornel, who has also played in the EuroLeague, in Baskonia, and is the only player that has played in the NBA. But yes, I think that for titles, at least, this has to continue to be that yes.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: David Kornel, que también ha jugado en la Euroliga, en Baskonia, y es el único jugador que ha jugado en la NBA. Pero sí, yo creo que por títulos por lo menos esto tiene que seguir que sí.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on his fame in Spain versus Hungary
quotes.excerpt: I think that I am a little more famous here in Spain because in the last years.
quotes.quote: I think that I am a little more famous here in Spain because in the last years, all my games are on TV, I have many more interviews, the people see much more, they see my games, because in Hungary, they do not see my games, there is not even a channel that has the right to show the games.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo creo que estoy un poco más famoso aquí en España porque los últimos años todos mis partidos están en la tele, tengo mucho más entrevistas, la gente se ve mucho más, se ve mis partidos, porque en Hungría no se ve mis partidos, no hay ni hay un canal que tiene derecho para para hacer los partidos.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on experiencing racism in Hungary
quotes.excerpt: Obviously, there was racism in this era of the 90s in Hungary, there are not many children.
quotes.quote: Obviously, there was racism in this era of the 90s in Hungary, there are not many children like me in this area where I lived, and for that reason, there were some hard moments, but thanks to my mother who has always given me a lesson of how to treat these situations, and always has treated with much joy, I would say, of never, they cannot do damage by insulting me for my color, no? Always smiled or not say anything or said something like that.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Obviamente, había racismo en esta época de los 90 en Hungría, no hay muchos niños como yo en esta zona donde vivía yo, y por eso fue momentos algunos duros, pero gracias a mi madre que siempre me ha dado una lección de cómo tratar estas situaciones, y siempre ha tratado con mucha alegría, diría, de nunca, no pueden hacer daño por insultarme por mi color, ¿no? Siempre sonreído o no decir nada o dicho algo así.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on his family's living situation in Hungary
quotes.excerpt: We lived in an apartment of 40 or 50 square meters, and we were four.
quotes.quote: We lived in an apartment of 40 or 50 square meters, and we were four. I lived with my mother until I was 14 years old in the same room, but but well, a part of this, much love, so I could not ask for more.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Vivíamos en un apartamento de 40 o 50 metros cuadrados, y éramos cuatro. Yo vivía con mi madre hasta que tenía 14 años en la misma habitación, pero pero bueno, una parte de esto, mucho amor, así que no podría pedir más.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on buying an apartment for his grandmother

quotes.quote: I bought an apartment for my grandmother because she lived in the same apartment where I grew up, but it cost a lot to take it from there, and I did not want to leave, and look, almost more than 40 years living in the same apartment, and I remember that the apartment was prepared, not know what, and always says, no, no, wait, I will wait until Christmas, no, no, I will wait until it is good weather, not know what, I say, please grandmother, it is already there and prepared and you have to go because I do not know.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo compré un apartamento para mi abuela porque vivía en la misma apartamento donde yo crecí, pero ha costado un montón de sacarlo desde ahí, y no quería salir, y mira, casi más de 40 años viviendo en la misma apartamento, y yo recuerdo que ya la apartamento estaba preparado, no sé qué y siempre dice, no, no, espera, voy a esperar hasta las Navidad, no, no, voy a esperar hasta cuando hace buen tiempo, no sé qué, digo, por favor abuela, ya está ahí y preparada y tienes que ir porque no sé.

quotes.speaker: Adam Hanga
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Hanga on cultural differences between Spain and Hungary
quotes.excerpt: First, of all this closed during the day, this I did not like, I remember.
quotes.quote: First, of all this closed during the day, this I did not like, I remember. Since one until five in the afternoon, no, and yes, but in my country, this does not exist. And then, for example, of going to a restaurant, and of course, there is a stage from one until five, you can go to eat and then it closes and then it opens, no? In my country, also this does not exist. From 11 in the morning until 10 at night, it is open and you can go to eat when you want.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Primero, de todo esto cerrado durante el día, esto no me gustaba, yo recuerdo. Desde la una hasta las cinco de la tarde, no, y sí, pero en mi país esto no existe. Y luego, por ejemplo, de ir a un restaurante, y claro, hay una etapa desde la una hasta las cinco, puedes ir a comer y luego se cierra y luego se abre, ¿no? En mi país tampoco existe esto. Desde las 11 de la mañana hasta las 10 de la noche está abierto y tú puedes ir a comer cuando quieres.

quotes.quote: I was obsessed with the EuroLeague, and I think that also it has affected me a lot, because in the end, you cannot be so obsessed with one thing like this, and I always was thinking that if I do not win the EuroLeague, this was a seal in my career that no sé, no has achieved everything that I wanted, no? And when we have won, it was a liberation, mother of mine.
